column1: # Canonical origin https://github.com/review-bench/ReviewBench at the exact commit
# 66df3f322d0d85ea133ea9fa777f5d1a8c933c4e. The corpus is admitted ONLY after an
# actual acquisition verifies that corpus/manifest.json is the git blob
